collect_diagnostics.title: Collect device diagnostics
collect_diagnostics.hint: Slow computer, crashes, low disk space, general 'something is wrong' reports. Safe first step when unsure.

flush_dns.title: Flush DNS cache
flush_dns.hint: Websites or internal hostnames not resolving, 'server not found', DNS_PROBE errors, a site works on phone but not laptop.

reset_network_adapters.title: Reset network adapters

Mode.description: Soft = bounce adapters. Full = also reset Winsock/TCP-IP stack (Windows needs a reboot afterwards).

reset_network_adapters.hint: No internet, limited connectivity, Wi-Fi connected but nothing loads, adapter stuck. Use Full only if Soft was already tried.

clear_temp_files.title: Clear temporary files

AgeDays.description: Only delete temp files older than this many days (1-90).

clear_temp_files.hint: Disk full, low storage warnings, slow performance caused by temp/cache build-up.

restart_print_spooler.title: Restart print spooler and clear stuck jobs
restart_print_spooler.hint: Printer not printing, jobs stuck in queue, 'printer offline' while the printer itself is on.

clear_teams_cache.title: Clear Microsoft Teams cache
clear_teams_cache.hint: Teams won't load, stuck signing in, blank white screen, missing chats/channels, status stuck.

install_software.title: Install approved software

Software.description: Logical package name from the approved software list.

install_software.hint: User asks for an application to be installed. Only packages on the approved list; anything else needs a human.

antivirus_scan.title: Run antivirus scan

ScanType.description: QuickScan takes minutes; FullScan can take hours.

antivirus_scan.hint: Suspected malware, pop-ups, suspicious file opened, security alert on the device.

scan_updates.title: Scan for missing OS patches
scan_updates.hint: Is my machine up to date, patch compliance check, security update status.

ad_unlock_account.title: Unlock on-prem Active Directory account
ad_unlock_account.hint: Domain account locked out after too many wrong passwords (on-prem AD).

ad_add_group_member.title: Add user to on-prem AD group
ad_add_group_member.hint: Access to a network share, VPN, Wi-Fi or printer that is controlled by an on-prem AD group.

entra_reset_password.title: Reset Entra ID (Microsoft 365) password

UserPrincipalName.description: Target user's UPN. Defaults to the requester.

entra_reset_password.hint: Forgot Microsoft 365 / Outlook / Teams password, password expired. A temporary password is issued and must be changed at next sign-in.

entra_revoke_sessions.title: Sign out of all Microsoft 365 sessions

UserPrincipalName.description: Target user's UPN. Defaults to the requester.

entra_revoke_sessions.hint: Lost/stolen phone or laptop, suspected account compromise, clicked a phishing link, 'sign me out everywhere'.

entra_add_group_member.title: Add user to Entra ID / M365 group
entra_add_group_member.hint: Access to a Team, SharePoint site, shared mailbox or app controlled by an Entra/M365 group.

entra_create_user.title: Create Entra ID (Microsoft 365) user

DisplayName.description: Full name of the new user.

UserPrincipalName.description: New user's UPN (must be in an allowed domain).

entra_create_user.hint: New joiner / onboarding: create an account for a new staff member.
